subject: Request: Short eval rollover + license swap for NovaScale POC
messages:
From: Emma Lin <emma@novascale.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@novascale.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short extension + convert remaining trial to timebox?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the NovaScale infra team and our ML folks ran some load tests and we hit the token cap faster than expected. Procurement is asking for a very small runway to finish procurement + security checks (2 weeks would get us to a signed SOW). Two asks:

1) Can Redwood give a two-week evaluation rollover so our engineers can complete the final eval?
2) If we do convert remaining trial usage into a short-term timebox license (we'd prefer a simple timebox vs per-seat), can you give a sense of discounting or a credit we could apply?

We have a tight budget cycle this month — if we can show a modest purchase path (any documented concession), procurement will escalate.

Attached is a short usage report for May so you can see our consumption pattern.

Attachments: usage_report_202605.csv (stub)

Appreciate a quick note back — Emma

--
Emma Lin
Head of ML Platform, NovaScale
emma@novascale.ai
+1 415-555-0147
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lin <emma@novascale.ai>
Cc: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@novascale.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension + convert remaining trial to timebox?

Hi Emma — thanks for the context and for sending the usage file. Quick responses and two paths we can offer:

Option A — Short rollover (no price change):
- Two-week evaluation rollover with existing trial configuration.
- Throughput capped at current concurrency to avoid capacity impact.
- No additional charge.
- No change to licensing (stays as trial).

Option B — Convert remaining trial to a timebox license (preferred for procurement):
- Convert unused trial token pool into a 3-month timebox SKU.
- Offer a one-time conversion credit equal to 15% of the converted value (applied to first invoice).
- Small minimum commitment required: $8k over 3 months (covers projected usage in your report).

If procurement needs a documented concession beyond the 15% conversion credit (or a price concession on the timebox SKU), I can request a one-time approval from my manager. For speed, can you confirm which path procurement prefers and whether they need a written SOW amendment or a DocuSign addendum?

Attaching a quick SOW draft and the usage report (for internal reference).

Attachments: NovaScale_SOW_draft.pdf (stub), usage_report_202605.csv (referenced earlier)

Cheers,
Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Emma Lin <emma@novascale.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T12:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension + convert remaining trial to timebox?

Jonas — thanks, Option B sounds like the best path for procurement (timebox + credit). Two quick clarifications: 

• Would the $8k minimum be invoiced up front or billed monthly? Procurement prefers monthly billing if possible.
• If we accept the 15% conversion credit, can we also have a documented note that this is a one-time concession for the POC and doesn’t indicate future pricing? They want language like “one-time POC conversion credit applied to initial invoice.”

If you need me to escalate internally, I can — but getting a written approval from your side will help speed the finance review.

Emma
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

- Customer: NovaScale (deal NS-POC-2026-47)
- Ask: convert remaining trial consumption to 3-month timebox, apply 15% conversion credit, $8k minimum (customer prefers monthly billing).
- Procurement needs explicit wording that credit = one-time POC concession (no forward-looking pricing commitment).
- We may need a slightly higher concession to close quickly — recommend authorizing up to a 20% one-time credit OR a 2-week rollover + 15% if legal prefers fewer contract changes.

Related: SOW draft attached and usage_report_202605.csv. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890

Can we get an approval decision today? If approved, I'll send the SOW addendum via DocuSign and coordinate billing (tagging Karthik for invoice owner).
